title: Gazz the Gargantuan
summary: Wake Gazz by defeating the dreamwalkers, then adapt to his alternating combat modes.
overview: Wake Gazz by defeating the dreamwalkers, then adapt to his alternating combat modes.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Defeat the three dreamwalkers and prepare for Gazz to awaken.
When Gazz slows and flails, keep vulnerable players clear of the area-rampage pressure.
His later roar leads into Reflective Sheen; watch the change before committing spells.
A prolonged disengagement starts the event reset sequence.
